Mod.Name: QuickSL
Mod.Author: 米德
Mod.Description:
实时快速SL，将当铺状态切换至任意快照节点。
附带功能：快速鉴定、水质标注、双击调用放大镜、快进顾客对话、酿酒标注、化学辅助。
功能设置请在mod自带的面板中进行设置。
--- English ---
Quick save/load in real time: restore the pawnshop to any snapshot checkpoint.
Extras: quick appraisal, water-quality labels, double-click magnifying glass, faster customer dialogue, brewing annotations and chemistry assistance.
Configure features in the mod's own panel.
